item.title: Scenes From the 2026 Beijing World Humanoid Robot Games
item.description: The 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games have begun. 666 teams from around the world are competing with more than 2,000 humanoid robots. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia Customers Notified About AI-Related Price Hikes Above 15%
item.description: Some of Nvidia Corp.’s biggest customers have been told that the prices of servers containing its artificial intelligence chips are going up more than 15% in many cases with memory chip costs soaring.
item.dc:creator: Brody Ford and Ian King

item.title: Apollo’s Slok Says AI Weighs On Pay Without Cutting Jobs — Yet
item.description: Torsten Slok found something surprising when Apollo Global Management Inc. looked at how the adoption of artificial intelligence was playing out in the labor market.
item.dc:creator: David Westin

item.title: ITG CFO: We're the Picks & Shovels of the AI Boom
item.description: Chris Mecray, CFO at ITG, joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the company's performance since its July 1 IPO, and its role in the AI buildout as a fiber and communications company. Mecray says ITG is "the picks and shovels of the AI boom... with a long runway of opportunity associated with creating the connectivity that data centers require once the actual site itself is built." Mecray speaks with Carol Massar, Emily Graffeo, and Nina Trentmann, CFO Briefing Editor. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Stocks Rally but End a Volatile Week Lower | The Close 8/21/2026
item.description: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are ProShares Head of Research & Active Investments CIO Alessio de Longis, KPMG Chief Economist Diane Swonk, Goldman Sachs Co-Head, Global Commodities Research Daan Struyven, Janus Henderson Portfolio Manager Jeremiah Buckley, National Academy of Engineering President Tsu-Jae King Liu, Loop CEO Matt McKinney, Liquid Death Founder & CEO Mike Cessario, Legendary Sports Agent Leigh Steinberg, & Boxer Mike Tyson. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Liquid Death CEO on Viral AI Data Center Ad, IPO Odds
item.description: Mike Cessario, Founder and CEO of Liquid Death, joined the program to discuss the growing public sentiment against the rapid expansion of data centers. Despite widespread interest in AI investments, the mood around data center growth has been notably negative. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Chip Engineer Tsu-Jae King Liu on Nvidia, AI Energy Need
item.description: Doctor Tsu-Jae King Liu, President of the National Academy of Engineering and Former Dean of UC Berkeley's College of Engineering, joined the program to discuss her influential role in the semiconductor industry. Having served on the board of Intel and contributed to the design of chips found in mobile phones, she shared insights into the technological advancements and impact of semiconductors in everyday devices. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Swonk: Fed Independence, Inflation Key for Jackson Hole
item.description: Diane Swonk, KPMG Chief Economist, discusses expectations for the upcoming Federal Reserve speech at the Jackson Hole Economic Symposium. The speech is traditionally technical and focused on internal task forces, but markets are seeking clearer guidance on inflation and monetary policy. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Sally Bakewell on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: TikTok to Pay $400 Million to Settle DOJ Child Privacy Case
item.description: TikTok Inc. and Chinese parent ByteDance Ltd. agreed to pay $400 million to resolve a a Biden-era lawsuit by the Justice Department accusing the popular social media app of collecting data on children in violation of an online privacy law.
item.dc:creator: Josh Sisco and Alexandra S. Levine

item.title: Anthropic Taps Google Chip Veteran as Part of Push Into Hardware
item.description: Anthropic PBC has hired Amir Salek, a founder of the custom chip program at Alphabet Inc.’s Google, as the AI lab lays the groundwork for a push into making its own semiconductors.
item.dc:creator: Dina Bass

item.title: Ask Emily Chang About Interviewing Tech’s Biggest Names on The Circuit
item.description: Emily Chang interviews the top names in tech and business on The Circuit. Bring your questions and join her for an interactive Live Q&A conversation on Sept. 1 at 1 p.m. EDT
item.dc:creator: Emily Chang and Brad Stone

item.title: SpaceX Is Hiring in Natural Gas Trading for Energy Needs
item.description: Elon Musk’s SpaceX is hiring a trader to build and lead a natural gas trading team to support the space flight company’s growing fuel and power needs.
item.dc:creator: Julian Hast

item.title: Treasury Whiplash, US Debt Hits $40T | Bloomberg Money 8/21/2026
item.description: Bloomberg Money takes the pulse of your financial life, powered by the reporting of our global newsroom. Today's guests: Rebecca Patterson, Council on Foreign Relations Senior Fellow, and Kevin Gordon, Charles Schwab Head of Macro Research & Strategy. (Source: Bloomberg)
